verdict.rationale: Stable documents a REST API (x-api-key auth, /v1 endpoints for locations, companies, and mail items) and webhooks, but nothing in the evidence mentions any official SDK or client library in any language. A raw HTTP API is an adjacent capability and does not count as an official SDK. Official SDKs are a fair question for a SaaS with a public API, so the absence of evidence is "none", not "na".
